quotes/packer-penal-substitution/text: Packer argues that penal substitution is the heart of the gospel: Jesus Christ, moved by love, endured in our place the penal judgement we deserved, so that we are forgiven, adopted and glorified — a truth to be confessed with wonder, not reduced to a mechanical theory.
quotes/stott-self-substitution/text: Stott describes the cross as the "self-substitution of God": the holy love of God satisfies itself by God himself, in the person of his Son, taking our place and bearing our penalty.
quotes/tf-torrance-vicarious-humanity/te: T. F. Torrance teaches that atonement takes place within the incarnate life of the Son: from the virgin birth to the ascension, Christ assumed our fallen humanity, healed and sanctified it from within, and offered it to the Father, so that the atonement is ontological as well as forensic.
quotes/justin-regenerated-in-water/text: Then they are brought by us where there is water, and are regenerated in the same manner in which we were ourselves regenerated. For, in the name of God, the Father and Lord of the universe, and of our Saviour Jesus Christ, and of the Holy Spirit, they then receive the washing with water.
quotes/tertullian-little-fishes/text: But we, little fishes, after the example of our ΙΧΘΥΣ Jesus Christ, are born in water, nor have we safety in any other way than by permanently abiding in water.
quotes/tertullian-delay-baptism/text: And so, according to the circumstances and disposition, and even age, of each individual, the delay of baptism is preferable; principally, however, in the case of little children.
quotes/origen-infant-tradition/text: Origen states that the Church received from the apostles the tradition of giving baptism even to little children, because there is in everyone the innate stain of sin that must be washed away by water and the Spirit.
quotes/cyprian-to-fidus/text: Cyprian reports that a council of sixty-six bishops rejected the view that infants should wait until the eighth day like circumcision: God’s grace and mercy are to be denied to no one born, least of all to the newborn.
quotes/cyril-grave-and-mother/text: And at the self-same moment ye were both dying and being born; and that Water of salvation was at once your grave and your mother.
quotes/augustine-infant-baptism-sin/text: Augustine argues that the universal custom of baptising infants "for the remission of sins", with exorcism and renunciation, proves that even newborns share the sin of Adam and need Christ the Saviour.
quotes/luther-baptism-gives/text: It works forgiveness of sins, delivers from death and the devil, and gives eternal salvation to all who believe this, as the words and promises of God declare.
quotes/luther-not-the-water/text: It is not the water indeed that does them, but the word of God which is in and with the water, and faith, which trusts such word of God in the water.
quotes/calvin-initiatory-sign/text: Baptism is the initiatory sign by which we are admitted to the fellowship of the Church, that being ingrafted into Christ we may be accounted children of God.
quotes/zwingli-baptism-pledge/text: Zwingli argues that sacraments are pledges or signs of allegiance, like the white cross a Swiss confederate sews on his coat; baptism does not cleanse the soul, but marks those who belong to God’s people, and the children of Christians belong to the covenant as Israel’s children were circumcised.
quotes/hubmaier-order-of-christ/text: Hubmaier insists on the order of Christ’s command — first preaching, then faith, then baptism — so that baptism is the public pledge of one who has already believed and commits himself to live according to the Rule of Christ.
quotes/schleitheim-article-one/text: The first Schleitheim article reserves baptism for all who have learned repentance and amendment of life, believe that their sins are taken away by Christ, and wish to walk in his resurrection; it rejects infant baptism as the chief abomination of the pope.
quotes/menno-baptism-obedience/text: Menno teaches that we are not cleansed by the water of baptism but by the blood of Christ received in faith; believers are baptised in obedience to Christ’s command as a sign of the new birth they have already received.
quotes/campbell-remission/text: Campbell teaches that immersion is the divinely appointed act in which the penitent believer receives the formal, personal remission of sins promised in Acts 2:38 — not a work that earns forgiveness but the moment God assures it.
quotes/ewart-jesus-name/text: Ewart argued that the apostles everywhere baptised "in the name of Jesus", which is the one saving name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit, so that Matthew 28:19 is fulfilled by Acts 2:38.
quotes/seymour-spirit-on-sanctified/text: The Azusa Street paper taught that the baptism with the Holy Ghost is a gift of power upon the sanctified life, evidenced by speaking in tongues as on the day of Pentecost.
quotes/dunn-conversion-initiation/text: Dunn argues that in the New Testament the gift of the Spirit is the chief element in conversion-initiation: to become a Christian is to receive the Spirit, so that "baptism in the Spirit" names the beginning of Christian life, not a later stage.
quotes/ignatius-one-physician/text: There is one Physician who is possessed both of flesh and spirit; both made and not made; God existing in flesh; true life in death; both of Mary and of God; first passible and then impassible, even Jesus Christ our Lord.
quotes/ignatius-seemed-to-suffer/text: But if, as some that are without God, that is, the unbelieving, say, that He only seemed to suffer (they themselves only seeming to exist), then why am I in bonds?
quotes/ignatius-eucharist-flesh/text: They abstain from the Eucharist and from prayer, because they confess not the Eucharist to be the flesh of our Saviour Jesus Christ, which suffered for our sins, and which the Father, of His goodness, raised up again.
quotes/irenaeus-became-what-we-are/text: …the only true and steadfast Teacher, the Word of God, our Lord Jesus Christ, who did, through His transcendent love, become what we are, that He might bring us to be even what He is Himself.
quotes/gregory-nazianzus-unassumed/text: For that which He has not assumed He has not healed; but that which is united to His Godhead is also saved.
quotes/nestorius-two-months-old/text: According to the church historian Socrates, Nestorius declared that he could not call ‘God’ one who had been two or three months old — objecting to language that attributed infancy and birth to the divine nature.
quotes/cyril-anathema-theotokos/text: If anyone will not confess that the Emmanuel is very God, and that therefore the Holy Virgin is the Mother of God (Θεοτόκος), inasmuch as in the flesh she bore the Word of God made flesh, let him be anathema.
quotes/cyril-one-incarnate-nature/text: Cyril maintains that after the union we should speak of ‘one incarnate nature of God the Word’, while insisting that the flesh remains flesh and is not changed into the nature of the Godhead.
quotes/leo-each-form/text: For each form does the acts which belong to it, in communion with the other; that is the Word performing what appertains to the Word, and the flesh carrying out what appertains to the flesh.
quotes/maximus-two-wills/text: Maximus argues that willing is a property of nature, not of person: since Christ is consubstantial with the Father in his divinity and with us in his humanity, he wills naturally as God and as man, and in Gethsemane his human will freely conformed itself to the divine.
quotes/schleiermacher-god-consciousness/: Schleiermacher holds that the Redeemer is like all human beings in virtue of his identical human nature, but distinguished from them all by the constant potency of his God-consciousness, which was a veritable existence of God in him.
quotes/clement-strife-episcopate/text: Our apostles also knew, through our Lord Jesus Christ, that there would be strife on account of the office of the episcopate.
quotes/ignatius-follow-the-bishop/text: See that ye all follow the bishop, even as Jesus Christ does the Father, and the presbytery as ye would the apostles ... Wherever the bishop shall appear, there let the multitude of the people also be; even as, wherever Jesus Christ is, there is the Catholic Church.
quotes/justin-not-common-bread/text: For not as common bread and common drink do we receive these; but in like manner as Jesus Christ our Saviour, having been made flesh by the Word of God, had both flesh and blood for our salvation, so likewise have we been taught that the food which is blessed by the prayer of His word, and from which our blood and flesh by transmutation are nourished, is the flesh and blood of that Jesus who was made flesh.
quotes/irenaeus-succession-of-bishops/te: It is within the power of all, therefore, in every Church, who may wish to see the truth, to contemplate clearly the tradition of the apostles manifested throughout the whole world; and we are in a position to reckon up those who were by the apostles instituted bishops in the Churches, and to demonstrate the succession of these men to our own times.
quotes/cyprian-church-mother/text: He can no longer have God for his Father, who has not the Church for his mother.
quotes/cyril-jerusalem-seeming-bread/tex: Cyril tells the newly baptised that what appears to be bread is not bread, though it tastes like bread, but the Body of Christ, and what appears to be wine is not wine but the Blood of Christ; they should not judge by taste but be fully assured by faith.
quotes/augustine-visible-word/text: The word is added to the element, and there results the Sacrament, as if itself also a kind of visible word.
quotes/augustine-he-that-baptizeth/text: Peter may baptize, but this is He that baptizeth; Paul may baptize, yet this is He that baptizeth; Judas may baptize, still this is He that baptizeth.
quotes/john-damascus-not-figures/text: The bread and the wine are not merely figures of the body and blood of Christ (God forbid!) but the deified body of the Lord itself.
quotes/luther-small-catechism-altar/text: It is the true body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, under the bread and wine, for us Christians to eat and to drink, instituted by Christ Himself.
quotes/zwingli-is-signifies/text: Zwingli argued that in "this is my body" the word "is" must be taken as "signifies", as in "I am the vine"; since "the flesh profiteth nothing" (John 6:63) and Christ’s body is at the right hand of God, the Supper is a thankful remembrance in which the believing community confesses its faith.
quotes/marburg-article-15/text: The fifteenth Marburg Article records agreement that the Supper should be received in both kinds, that it is a sacrament of the true body and blood of Christ, and that spiritual partaking of that body and blood is necessary; but the parties "have not at this time agreed" whether the true body and blood are bodily present in the bread and wine, and each should show the other Christian love as far as conscience allows.
quotes/calvin-spirit-unites/text: What our mind does not comprehend, let faith conceive, viz., that the Spirit truly unites things separated by space.
quotes/articles-two-sacraments/text: There are two Sacraments ordained of Christ our Lord in the Gospel, that is to say, Baptism, and the Supper of the Lord. Those five commonly called Sacraments, that is to say, Confirmation, Penance, Orders, Matrimony, and extreme Unction, are not to be counted for Sacraments of the Gospel.
